About

A designer who also builds the page the design lives on

I design marketing visuals, branding materials and social media graphics for events, campaigns and client projects, translating brand guidelines into finished, platform-ready assets. Certified in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign and CorelDraw, with a growing portfolio spanning cultural festival greetings, awareness campaigns and brand identity work. Alongside design, I shoot and edit photography for events and freelance clients, independently managing multiple concurrent projects to deadline.

"Design that holds up whether it's printed, posted, or coded into a page."
